final: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) as actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id), first_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(actor_count AS DECIMAL)) as avg_val FROM actor_counts), above_first AS (SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, fav.avg_val as first_avg FROM actor_counts ac, first_avg_val fav WHERE fav.avg_val IS NOT NULL AND ac.actor_count > fav.avg_val), second_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(actor_count AS DECIMAL)) as avg_val FROM above_first), above_second AS (SELECT af.film_id, af.actor_count, af.first_avg, sav.avg_val as second_avg FROM above_first af, second_avg_val sav WHERE sav.avg_val IS NOT NULL AND af.actor_count > sav.avg_val) SELECT SUM(actor_count) as sum_actors, AVG(CAST(actor_count - first_avg AS DECIMAL)) as avg_excess_1, AVG(CAST(actor_count - second_avg AS DECIMAL)) as avg_excess_2 FROM above_second
